Announcement • Jun 11

### Ionis Pharmaceuticals Doses First Participant In Phase 3 Study For Angelman Syndrome Treatment

Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. announced that the first participant has been dosed in the global Phase 3 REVEAL study, which is designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ION582, an investigational medicine for the treatment of people living with Angelman syndrome (AS), a serious and rare neurodevelopmental disorder that leads to significant physical and cognitive impairments. REVEAL (NCT06914609) is a global, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 study that will enroll approximately 200 children and adults with AS that have a maternal UBE3A gene deletion or mutation. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### HALOS (obudanersen Phase 1/2) ↗ (opens in a new tab)

Obudanersen (ION582) · Ionis Pharmaceuticals

ASO: Antisense drug given by spinal injection that targets UBE3A-ATS so the father's silent UBE3A copy can switch on

Early study of obudanersen (ION582) at rising doses by spinal injection, then long-term dosing, in people with a deletion or UBE3A mutation; 71 enrolled. In 2024 Ionis reported on the first 51: well tolerated, with skill gains beyond natural history studies (not a direct comparison). No placebo group. Not enrolling.

Result: Safety was the main goal. In May 2024 Ionis said obudanersen was safe and well tolerated at all doses in the first 51 people. It also reported gains in thinking, communication and movement beyond natural history studies, without a direct comparison. Full results are not yet public.
